newsitem.title: UK: Sema to buy France Telecom's TELIS business.
newsitem.headline: Sema to buy France Telecom's TELIS business.

text.p: Anglo-French communications technology firm Sema Group said on Wednesday it is to buy France Telecom's information systems subsidiary TELIS.
The company also said it is to acquire the remaining 50 percent of Sema Group Telecom which it does not already own.

Sema is to pay a total cash consideration of 25 million francs for the acquisition. TELIS was formed by France Telecom last year and has turnover of more than 900 million francs. It employs more than 2,000 people.

"The acquisition of TELIS is a natural progression of the very positive relationship which exists between Sema Group and France Telecom and represents a major strategic step forward in Sema Group's operations in France," Sema's chief executive Pierre Bonelli said in a statement.
